headline: Earnings climb sharply from a year ago
summary_short: Doosan Enerbility's Q2 FY2026 EPS was ₩247, up about 21% y/y from ₩204, and a sharp rebound from just ₩1 in Q1 FY2026.
summary_long: EPS was ₩247 in Q2 FY2026, up roughly 21% y/y from ₩204 and up sharply q/q from just ₩1 in Q1 FY2026. No revenue, margin, or cash-position figures are available from verified shard data for this kpi-only pass.
